subject: Greenpointe passkey enrollment failing — invite redirect during onboarding
messages:
From: Li Chen <li.chen@greenpointe.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Unable to accept supplier invite — passkey enrollment redirects to 403

Hi Jordan,

We got the supplier invite for Greenpointe this morning but when my colleague tries to complete the account set up the browser drops to a 403 on the passkey enrollment step. We tried Chrome and Safari (macOS 12.6) and saw the same redirect. I attached a screenshot of the console and the invite link preview.

This is holding up a live PO (PO# GP-4621) — can you help us get a way to accept the invite (or provide a one-time fallback)? Happy to share the user’s email if that helps.

Thanks,
Li Chen
Procurement Ops — Greenpointe Supply Co.
Attachments: screenshot-passkey-403.png
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Li Chen <li.chen@greenpointe.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 09:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unable to accept supplier invite — passkey enrollment redirects to 403

Hi Li — thanks for the quick report and the screenshot. Sorry for the friction here; we’ll get this sorted ASAP.

A couple quick asks so we can triage faster:
- Can you confirm the exact email address the invite was sent to (we need it to look up the token).
- Do you see any browser extensions (adblock, privacy tools) enabled?
- If possible, can the user try an incognito/private window and report back the behavior?

Workaround we can offer immediately: we can issue a single-use fallback acceptance link (expires in 6 hours) or switch the invite to passcode entry instead of passkey enrollment. Which do you prefer? If you want the fallback link I’ll generate and send it now.

Looping Ben and Soojin for visibility — Ben, Soojin, this looks like a relay/redirect problem near the passkey step for Greenpointe’s tenant. Can you take point on logs and whether a temporary link is safe to issue?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Li Chen <li.chen@greenpointe.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unable to accept supplier invite — passkey enrollment redirects to 403

On Tue, Dec 14, 2027 at 09:03 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Li — thanks for the quick report and the screenshot. Sorry for the friction here; we’ll get this sorted ASAP.
> 
> A couple quick asks so we can triage faster:
> - Can you confirm the exact email address the invite was sent to (we need it to look up the token).
> - Do you see any browser extensions (adblock, privacy tools) enabled?
> - If possible, can the user try an incognito/private window and report back the behavior?
> 
> Workaround we can offer immediately: we can issue a single-use fallback acceptance link (expires in 6 hours) or switch the invite to passcode entry instead of passkey enrollment. Which do you prefer? If you want the fallback link I’ll generate and send it now.

Thanks for the tag — I pulled the invite token for Greenpointe (org_id: gp-77a). From the auth logs it looks like RelayState is being trimmed by an intermediate redirect on their side which is dropping the HMAC validation when we get to the passkey step. The passkey enrollment path rejects the request with 403 when the token payload is missing.

Immediate plan:
- I can generate a temporary one-time accept URL that bypasses the RelayState path (expires in 6 hours). That will let the vendor accept and finish onboarding so the PO can flow.
- Engineering (Soojin) to follow up and add a tolerant fallback for trimmed relay states in the next patch; we’ll track a postmortem for tenant gp-77a.

Soojin — can you confirm you’ll take the logs and file a short remediation ticket (include the auth trace id: a1b2c3-gp77a) and estimate timeline?

Jordan — Jordan, I’ll issue the temporary accept URL after you confirm Li’s preferred fallback.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Technical Account Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Li Chen <li.chen@greenpointe.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unable to accept supplier invite — passkey enrollment redirects to 403

Hi Jordan and team — thanks, fallback link worked. Our procurement user used the temporary acceptance URL and was able to complete profile creation and upload the signed W9 (attached). PO GP-4621 moved to Ready to Pay.

Notes for your follow-up: the user was on Chrome 118 with an enterprise web filter that rewrites redirects (we’ll flag this to our security team). Appreciate the fast help and the follow-up remediation.

Attached: w9-greenpointe.pdf

Best regards,
Li Chen
Procurement Ops — Greenpointe Supply Co.
